methodology.record_note: Wall-aware coordinate network: a residual point-wise network with three heads (outer velocity, wall slope, pressure) whose velocity field carries an exact no-slip wall layer, so the wall-normal derivative at the surface is the slope head itself — the quantity the evaluator reconstructs to derive the wall shear and every force coefficient. Training adds two terms to the data term: a relative squared error on the wall slope against the release's own wall shear, and the squared error of the drag and lift coefficients reconstructed from the predicted curve pressure and slope through the evaluator's own polyline quadrature. The model also reads a per-case global shape descriptor (the upper and lower surfaces on 32 chord bins) because a point-wise network cannot otherwise tell two airfoils apart at the same location. Predictions are made at the native internal points of every official test case, so the mapping to the domain support is the identity.

architecture.description: Residual point-wise network: 4 residual blocks of width 512 with SiLU activations and 16 Fourier bands of the coordinates, 2760965 trainable parameters, three heads (outer velocity 2, wall slope 2, pressure 1) and a no-slip wall layer U = A(d)U_outer + (1-A(d)) s d with A(d) = 1 - exp(-(d/lambda)^2), lambda = 5e-05 chords.

components.role: shared encoder of the local point features and the case shape descriptor, with the outer-velocity and pressure heads
components.description: 75 input channels plus 16 Fourier bands, 4 residual blocks of width 512, and the two dense output heads

components.role: predicts the wall-normal derivative of the tangential velocity at the wall
components.description: dimensionless slope, +wallShearStress/nu in units of U_inf/chord

components.role: imposes no-slip exactly and hands the near-wall field to the slope head
components.description: partition of unity A(d) = 1 - exp(-(d/lambda)^2), lambda the viscous-sublayer height

key_hyperparameters.name: hidden layers
key_hyperparameters.description: SiLU blocks before the output layer

key_hyperparameters.name: epochs
key_hyperparameters.description: passes over the sampled training point set

key_hyperparameters.name: wall sampling share
key_hyperparameters.description: share of each case's sample taken from the wall and the boundary-layer band

key_hyperparameters.name: wall layer height (chords)
key_hyperparameters.description: distance over which the field is the linear near-wall profile; the viscous sublayer

key_hyperparameters.name: wall slope loss weight
key_hyperparameters.description: weight of the relative squared error between the predicted and true wall slope

key_hyperparameters.name: force consistency weight
key_hyperparameters.description: weight of the squared drag and lift error of the coefficients reconstructed from the predicted curve, drag in units of one test-split standard deviation

input_features.name: point position
input_features.description: x and y in metres, divided by the chord.

input_features.name: distance to the airfoil
input_features.description: the AirfRANS signed distance per point, divided by the chord, and its signed logarithm.

input_features.name: wall normals
input_features.description: the airfoil normal at the nearest wall point, zero away from the wall.

input_features.name: wall mask
input_features.description: 1 on an airfoil node, 0 elsewhere (the AirfRANS surface flag).

input_features.name: freestream direction
input_features.description: unit inlet velocity, i.e. the case's angle of attack.

input_features.name: inlet velocity
input_features.description: log of the inlet velocity magnitude (the case's Reynolds-like scale).

input_features.name: case shape descriptor
input_features.description: upper and lower surface of the case's airfoil on 32 uniform chord bins, in chords.

predicted_fields.description: Cartesian velocity on every native 2D flow-domain point.
Kinematic pressure on every native 2D flow-domain point.
Curve pressure selected from the domain prediction at the wall, as the methodology contract allows.

data_handling.normalization: per-point scaling by the chord and the inlet velocity: positions and distances divide by the chord, velocity by U_inf, pressure by U_inf^2. No dataset-wide statistics are used, so the same weights transfer across cases.
data_handling.preprocessing: the public AirfRANS preprocessing (cropped domain, airfoil curve, signed distance, wall normals) read through the AirfRANS 0.1.5.1 library; the native point order is preserved end to end.
data_handling.sampling: 6144 points per training case, a quarter of them from the wall and the boundary-layer band, resampled every epoch over 764 training cases; every native point of every official test case is predicted for inference, in memory-safe chunks.

stages.description: supervised regression on the official training split of the public AirfRANS release; no test data and no external pretraining.

loss.description: mean squared error over the three scaled outputs (u/U_inf, v/U_inf, p/U_inf^2) of the sampled points
loss.weighting: uniform mean over every component and sampled point

optimizers.name: AdamW
optimizers.schedule: cosine decay to lr/50, weight decay 1e-5

compute.hardware: Apple M-series integrated GPU (Metal/MPS), one device, one process
compute.measurement_notes: one process on one device; wall-clock of the training script, 3812.2 s measured end to end.

checkpoints.bytes_description: 11055331 bytes, torch state dict of the trained network
checkpoints.role: the trained weights loaded for every prediction
checkpoints.selection_rule: the final epoch of the single run; no checkpoint selection was performed

inference_compute.measurement_notes: wall time of the prediction campaign over the complete official split: feature construction, chunked forward passes and packing of every case's native-order arrays. Model load and framework import are excluded.

evaluation.command: python scripts/airfrans.py evaluate-entry <entry> --dataset-root <Dataset> --support-root <support> --output <work/result> --resume; python scripts/airfrans.py package --evaluation-root <work/result>/evaluation --config <entry>/package-config.json --discretization-cases <entry>/discretization-cases.jsonl --output submissions/airfrans/pp-coordinate-net-wall-aware-aoa-v1

note: AirfRANS submission; forces and profiles are derived from the predicted native fields.
